answer: What keeps this honest is Certified network engineer outage log with network engineers endorsement, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 604 aliases need 604 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. One tide of signal, one river of cost, one jade of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
